videos.title: Hands on with Amazon Kindle Click
videos.description:
Amazon introduced the Bluetooth page-turning remote called the Kindle Click. The $34.99 clicker has two big buttons for turning back and forward on e-books and two buttons on the right side for adjusting screen brightness. It’s basically Amazon’s answer to page-turning remotes like the Boox Tappy.

The only catch is that the Kindle Click supports Kindles from 2024 or later. Sorry, older Kindles are SOL.

For more on the Kindle Click and the newest lineup Kindles, tap our link in bio.

videos.description:

With a slimmer, lighter, and customizable design, the Beats 360 are the better pair of over-ear ANC wireless headphones for workouts compared to AirPods Max 2.

We got our hands on them briefly and were impressed. At $350, they're $200 cheaper than the AirPods Max 2. And until October 31, extra cushions are only $10.
